correctness.rationale: All hypotheses and the squared-HS normalization are explicit. The global classical moment cone reduces after antipodal averaging to all positive semidefinite trace-one 3x3 matrices. A feasible rank-two candidate T* satisfies the variational inequality for every PSD competitor, giving a unique minimizer and exact norm squared 3 lambda^2/8. Its three-direction coherent measure has correct zero mean/covariance and minimal atom number by Bloch rank. The exact unitary similarity of partial transpose to X/2 gives negativity -lambda/2, with lambda>=0 boundary handled separately. The nonaxial example and 342 rational tests replay exactly, but only the proof establishes continuum validity.
